image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched vertically on a green plant stem. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is light brown/tan with distinct rows of black eyespots (ocelli) ringed in yellow/white. The body is fuzzy and brown, and clubbed antennae are visible.
